$NFLX
  - DEUTSCHE BANK UPGRADES NETFLIX TO BUY

Deutsche Bank upgraded Netflix to Buy from Hold, citing its global scale, international production advantage and attractive valuation. The bank lowered its price target to $95 from $100.

Netflix now trades at roughly 18x estimated
